cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make the Choice Rewrite the Past
cards.instruction: Make them choose between options whose consequences reinterpret an earlier promise, refusal, or agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Choose the overseas job or our shared shop. Then we'll know what 'we'll build something' meant. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said that before the offer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Yes. This choice gives the old sentence its ending.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're making a job sound like a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking whether your promise has room for the shop without you.

mechanism: A insists a present career decision define an old joint-shop promise, then offers a modified business arrangement to keep B invested.
confusable: Generic abandonment fear lacks explicit alternative choices whose consequences give the earlier promise a new meaning.
comparison: Key alternative makes a quiet-evening agreement into a relationship decision rather than a business commitment.
seedUse: Shop seed supplies old build-something promise and overseas offer; S02 should change the demanded arrangement rather than offer abstract sentence analysis.
